mapper.select: SELECT source.id::text AS data_source_id, content.version AS content_version, content.object_key, content.sha256, content.byte_size, content.media_type, content.created_at AS content_created_at FROM knowledge_data.text_data_source source JOIN knowledge_data.text_data_source_content content ON content.tenant_id = source.tenant_id AND content.knowledge_space_id = source.knowledge_space_id AND content.data_source_id = source.id AND content.version = source.published_content_version WHERE source.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND source.knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND source.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY source.id FOR SHARE OF source, content
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_data.index_version ( tenant_id, knowledge_space_id, id, source_snapshot_digest, chunk_policy, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, status, version, build_digest, chunk_count, failure_code, created_by, created_at, ready_at, activated_at, superseded_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeSpaceId}, #{id}, #{sourceSnapshotDigest}, #{chunkPolicy}, #{embeddingDeploymentId}, #{embeddingDeploymentRevision}, #{embeddingDimension}, 'BUILDING', 0, NULL, 0, NULL, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, NULL, NULL, NULL )

INSERT INTO knowledge_data.index_version_source ( tenant_id, knowledge_space_id, index_version_id, data_source_id, content_version, object_key, sha256, byte_size, media_type, content_created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeSpaceId}, #{indexVersionId}, #{dataSourceId}, #{contentVersion}, #{objectKey}, #{sha256}, #{byteSize}, #{mediaType}, #{contentCreatedAt} )

INSERT INTO knowledge_data.index_build_job ( tenant_id, knowledge_space_id, index_version_id, status, attempt, lease_id, lease_until, failure_code, available_at, created_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeSpaceId}, #{indexVersionId}, 'PENDING', 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, NULL )

INSERT INTO knowledge_data.index_version_request ( tenant_id, operation, idempotency_key_hash, request_fingerprint, knowledge_space_id, index_version_id, result_status, result_version, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{operation}, #{keyHash}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{knowledgeSpaceId}, #{indexVersionId}, #{resultStatus}, #{resultVersion}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, id::text AS id, source_snapshot_digest, chunk_policy, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, status, version, build_digest, chunk_count, failure_code, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, ready_at, activated_at, superseded_at FROM knowledge_data.index_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND id = #{id}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, id::text AS id, source_snapshot_digest, chunk_policy, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, status, version, build_digest, chunk_count, failure_code, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, ready_at, activated_at, superseded_at FROM knowledge_data.index_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, id::text AS id, source_snapshot_digest, chunk_policy, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, status, version, build_digest, chunk_count, failure_code, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, ready_at, activated_at, superseded_at FROM knowledge_data.index_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, id::text AS id, source_snapshot_digest, chunk_policy, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, status, version, build_digest, chunk_count, failure_code, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, ready_at, activated_at, superseded_at FROM knowledge_data.index_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, id::text AS id, source_snapshot_digest, chunk_policy, embedding_deployment_id, embedding_deployment_revision, embedding_dimension, status, version, build_digest, chunk_count, failure_code, created_by::text AS created_by, created_at, ready_at, activated_at, superseded_at FROM knowledge_data.index_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND (created_at, id) < (#{createdAt}, #{id}) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id::text AS tenant_id, knowledge_space_id::text AS knowledge_space_id, index_version_id::text AS index_version_id, attempt FROM knowledge_data.index_build_job WHERE available_at <= #{now} AND ( status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ) ORDER BY available_at, created_at, index_version_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1

SELECT data_source_id::text AS data_source_id, content_version, object_key, sha256, byte_size, media_type, content_created_at FROM knowledge_data.index_version_source WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_space_id = #{knowledgeSpaceId} AND index_version_id = #{indexVersionId} ORDER BY data_source_id
